earlyTeardown: Pause after final complete or incomplete reconciliation and reporting
scope: Consolidation only: existing matrix and already-assigned final reconciliation/handoff

independentValidator.executionGate: Existing controller and all four workers have exited; original host and artifact path only
independentValidator.receiptRule: Save stdout to a new independent JSON receipt; never overwrite an existing artifact
independentValidator.passRule: Exit 0 AND validationStatus VALIDATED_FINAL_MATRIX AND complete true
independentValidator.refusalRule: Preserve incomplete/refused evidence; hand off without restarting

automationDisposition: Deleted by coordinator at user request; evidence heartbeat definition absent on disk; no schedule recreated
